description: TO_BOOLEAN accepts the full Snowflake input set: a NUMERIC value where 0 is false and any non-zero is true, and the text tokens true/t/yes/y/on/1 and false/f/no/n/off/0, case-insensitively. A numeric STRING like '2' is still an error - only the numeric 2 is truthy - and NULL passes through. Previously only true/1/yes/on and false/0/no/off were accepted and any numeric argument such as 2 threw. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToBooleanTest (now retired); the Java loops over token arrays become one projection per token set.

steps.sql: SELECT TO_BOOLEAN('true'), TO_BOOLEAN('t'), TO_BOOLEAN('yes'), TO_BOOLEAN('y'), TO_BOOLEAN('on'), TO_BOOLEAN('1'), TO_BOOLEAN('TRUE')
SELECT TO_BOOLEAN('false'), TO_BOOLEAN('f'), TO_BOOLEAN('no'), TO_BOOLEAN('n'), TO_BOOLEAN('off'), TO_BOOLEAN('0'), TO_BOOLEAN('FALSE')
